name: INS Dunagiri

header.one_liner: Nilgiri-class P17A stealth frigate; commissioned 6 Feb 2026 at MDL Mumbai; sister of Mahendragiri; BrahMos + Barak-8/ER; ~75% indigenous.
header.indigenous_label: ~75% indigenous content (P17A claim); propulsion GE LM2500, weapons partially imported

at_a_glance.Propulsion: COGAG — 2x GE LM2500 gas turbines + 2x MAN diesel engines
at_a_glance.ASW: Twin 324mm torpedo tubes + RBU-6000 + multi-role helicopter
at_a_glance.Class_size: 7 ships (Nilgiri, Udaygiri, Taragiri, Himgiri, Dunagiri, Mahendragiri, Vindhyagiri)

what_it_is.prose: INS Dunagiri is the sixth Nilgiri-class Project 17A (P17A) stealth frigate, named after a mountain peak in the Kumaon Himalaya. Built by MDL in Mumbai and commissioned on 6 February 2026, she shares the class's stealth-optimised design, COGAG propulsion based on GE LM2500 gas turbines, a 32-cell vertical launch system firing BrahMos and Barak-8/ER missiles, a 76mm main gun, close-in weapon systems, and an integrated ASW fit including torpedoes, an RBU-6000 rocket launcher and a multi-role helicopter. Dunagiri is a sister of INS Mahendragiri (commissioned 13 January 2026) and the lead ship Nilgiri (December 2025), completing the MDL tranche of the seven-ship P17A programme. The class represents India's most modern surface combatant line and is a flagship demonstration of the indigenous warship-building ecosystem at MDL and its extensive Indian vendor base.

deployments_procurement.summary: The P17A programme was sanctioned in 2015 for seven frigates at ~₹45,000 crore. INS Dunagiri was commissioned on 6 February 2026 at MDL Mumbai. With the class now complete (Nilgiri, Udaygiri, Taragiri, Himgiri, Dunagiri, Mahendragiri and Vindhyagiri), the frigates will distribute across the Indian Navy's two major commands for escort, air-defence and strike roles.

faq.question: When was INS Dunagiri commissioned?
faq.answer: INS Dunagiri was commissioned on 6 February 2026 at MDL Mumbai, making it the sixth Nilgiri-class P17A frigate to enter service.

faq.question: What is the significance of the Dunagiri name?
faq.answer: Dunagiri is named after a mountain peak (7,066 m) in the Kumaon Himalaya in Uttarakhand, continuing the Indian tradition of naming frigates after mountain ranges and peaks.

faq.question: How does Dunagiri compare to the earlier Shivalik class it replaces?
faq.answer: The P17A improves on the Shivalik class primarily through a fully stealth-optimised hull and superstructure, an integrated platform management system, higher indigenous content (~75%), and an upgraded suite of sensors and weapons in the same 32-cell VLS configuration.
